svg.title: MAXMotion velocity: ramp to the new speed
svg.desc: Animated graph of speed over time, drawn left to right, with a flywheel spinning beside it. A dotted gray line is what you ask for: it jumps to a new speed and later jumps back to 0. The dashed blue line is the SPARK's setpoint: it ramps to each new speed at your max acceleration instead of jumping. The solid orange measured speed follows the ramp, and the flywheel speeds up and slows down with it. For flywheels and rollers: smoother spin-up, less current, more consistent shots. It runs continuously, so never use it on something with hard stops. For a drivetrain, limiting each wheel separately can bend the robot's path while accelerating; a chassis-level limiter keeps the wheels in step.
svg.text: MAXMotion velocity: ramp to the new speed
Ask for a new speed; inside the SPARK it ramps there at your max acceleration.
For flywheels and rollers: smoother spin-up, less current, more consistent
shots. It runs continuously, so never use it on something with hard stops.
Drivetrain: limiting each wheel separately can bend the robot's path while
accelerating; a chassis-level limiter keeps the wheels in step.
